title: Server version disclosed (X-Generator header)
description: The response discloses a versioned X-Generator header banner. Version banners let attackers aim known exploits. This check matches the banner directly.
remediation: Immediate: suppress the banner using the control recorded for this stack (header removal), then confirm the header is gone from a success response, an error response and a static asset. Durable: normalise version banners at the reverse proxy or CDN so a framework upgrade cannot reintroduce one, and keep the component patched — hiding a version lowers reconnaissance value but does not fix a vulnerable release.
limitation: Banner check: version visibility alone is not exploitability.
